text: It always counts for the visa duration. But as a general advice: If you get so close to the max that you have to ask that question, you are stretching the limits of what they are willing to accept. The three month rule isn't an actual rule. It is a rough guideline that your case worker might regard as too generous. I have heard interpretations that basically claimed the standard vacation day arrangement for salaried employees as the orientation. So you can face people who view 6 weeks as the line where they start asking questions. Better make sure you know the exact interpretation of your branch and case worker.
